fields.why: The brief says age is recorded always, and the population is restricted to patients aged >=18 years; 'Living with a disability' is an employment-status row under Occupation (social position), a defensible descriptor. Neither changes level 1.

brief_issues: Whether a disability category listed under occupation/employment status counts as social-position framing is not stated explicitly; a rule that employment-status categories (unemployed, retired, disabled) are SES/social position would settle it.
